entity.summary: Sweden-based centralized cryptocurrency exchange and brokerage platform providing account-based buying, selling, custody, recurring purchases, and wallet services for Nordic customers.
entity.notes: Current first-party platform remains live and presents active exchange, wallet, BankID, Swish, and recurring-purchase services. Sweden's Finansinspektionen stated on July 1, 2026 that Safello AB had been approved as a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA. HEI records authorization as an operating fact, not as an endorsement or guarantee.

evidence.title: Safello official cryptocurrency exchange
evidence.notes: Current first-party platform presents live buy, sell, custody, wallet, BankID, Swish, and Auto-Save services under the Safello brand.

evidence.title: Crypto companies without authorization must wind down in the EU
evidence.notes: Swedish regulator states that Safello AB was approved as a crypto-asset service provider and may offer crypto services after the national MiCA transition ended.
